Marks a sound so that it plays in an endless loop whenever it is played from now on. It does not start the sound: call [PlaySound](PlaySound) for that. Channels that already play the sound are not changed. Stop a looping sound with [StopChannel](StopChannel).

```blitzbasic
; MakeBeep writes beep.wav, see the LoadSound example for the code.
Local snd = LoadSound("beep.wav")
LoopSound snd
Local ch = PlaySound(snd)
Delay 1800
StopChannel ch
```
@param sound  A handle from [LoadSound](LoadSound).
@gap There is no command to switch looping off again.
@gap A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the sound is 0 (a sound that failed to load) or does not exist, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
